## STABLE — frozen read-only workflow
This demo prepares lead data and creates no external writes. Replace the transformation with your read-only enrichment/classification. Keep the response envelope and output contract.
Configure Header Auth: x-releaseguard-upstream = UPSTREAM_TOKEN. Publish this workflow.
Demo fault fields are intentional test controls; remove them from your real workflow. Keep stable-v1 / candidate-v1 fixed during this release. Clone a new workflow for the next candidate.
